Story.label: Our Story
Story.title: HappyMom's mission is to improve postpartum care worldwide, focusing on emotional and physical support.

ServicesDetail.heroSubtitle: We propose premium care standards for both mother and baby.
ServicesDetail.postpartumDesc: HappyMom's postpartum care specialists go beyond simple help, taking responsibility for the mother's health recovery and the stable development of the newborn.
ServicesDetail.newbornGrowth: Growth Management: Recording and managing newborn logs, temperature measurement, and health checks.
ServicesDetail.newbornDev: Developmental Support: Newborn massage (promoting growth, emotional stability, and brain development).
ServicesDetail.newbornHygiene: Hygiene Management: Bathing, umbilical cord care, bottle sterilization, and pump management.
ServicesDetail.newbornClothing: Clothing Management: Washing newborn clothing and bedding.
ServicesDetail.maternalBody: Physical Recovery: Support for postpartum edema management and foot baths for blood circulation.
ServicesDetail.maternalBreast: Breastfeeding Specialization: Breast massage (preventing engorgement and pain relief) and breastfeeding posture guidance.
ServicesDetail.maternalHealing: Healing Support: Sitz bath management for perineal pain relief and wound healing.
ServicesDetail.maternalNutrition: Nutrition Management: Specialized postpartum meal and nutrition management for mother's recovery.
ServicesDetail.familyHygiene: Hygiene Environment: Cleaning the baby's room, maintaining a pleasant indoor environment, and kitchen cleanliness.
ServicesDetail.familySupport: Family Support: Preparing meals and snacks for the husband and older children, and simple laundry management.
ServicesDetail.familyOrg: Organization: Daily organization of children's toys and living spaces.
ServicesDetail.warningDesc: HappyMom postpartum care specialists are experts responsible for the health of both mother and newborn. They are not general housekeepers and focus on recovery and stability.
ServicesDetail.babysitDesc: So parents can focus on their daily lives with peace of mind, experienced caregivers warmly look after their children.
ServicesDetail.babysitExpert: Expertise: Placement of experienced specialists who understand infant development stages.
ServicesDetail.babysitSafety: Safety First: Indoor care you can trust even when parents are away.
ServicesDetail.babysitBond: Emotional Bond: A warm parenting service that goes beyond simple care to connect with the child.

Guide.heroTitle: A Happy Start with HappyMom, Service Application Process
Guide.heroSubtitle: From consultation to the start of service, HappyMom systematically helps mothers' comfortable recovery.
Guide.step01Desc: Please call the number at the bottom of the HappyMom website or request a consultation through the Contact page. We will check the due date and region for the initial consultation.
Guide.step02Title: Step 02. Detailed Service Explanation and Decision
Guide.step02Desc: Through a 1:1 consultation with the director, you can hear detailed explanations of the services and decide on the service you want.
Guide.step03Desc: We will send you a contract based on the consultation. After reviewing it carefully, please submit the completed contract via email (happymom7080@gmail.com).
Guide.step04Desc: Pay the deposit to confirm the reservation. Payments can be conveniently made through the HappyMom bank account or Venmo (account info provided separately).
Guide.step05Title: Step 05. Care Specialist Selection and Matching
Guide.step05Desc: Reflecting the mother's preferences and requests, HappyMom matches a carefully selected expert. We arrange a phone call or meeting with the selected caregiver.
Guide.step06Desc: On the promised date and time, a skilled postpartum care specialist is dispatched to the mother's home to begin high-quality care.
Guide.outOfStateDesc: Procedures and costs for services outside California may vary by region. We provide optimized personalized info through a separate consultation.
Guide.insuranceDesc: For mothers using workplace benefits like Carrot Fertility, we perfectly support necessary documents and receipt issuance.
Guide.scheduleDesc: If there is a change in the due date, please contact HappyMom as soon as you are hospitalized so we can adjust the caregiver assignment.

PricingDetail.heroTitle: Transparent and reasonable costs, promising beyond that

PricingDetail.basicConditions: ※ Basic service conditions are based on 3 people including mother, spouse, and newborn. Additional costs may apply if other family members reside together.
PricingDetail.longDistanceNote: Long Distance Guide: Long distance work is continuous without days off regardless of holidays. A 6-week contract is calculated as 30 continuous days, including weekends and holidays.
PricingDetail.babysitHours: 9 AM ~ 9 AM Next Day (Commuting: 9 AM ~ 6 PM)
PricingDetail.carrotTitle: Are you a Carrot Fertility member?
PricingDetail.carrotDesc: We are an officially certified provider for Carrot Fertility benefits. Our experts are certified by Childbirth International and IAP Career College.
PricingDetail.additionalFeesDesc: Additional fees are paid in full to the care specialist. If applicable, please check the corresponding items when filling out the contract.
PricingDetail.commutingAreaNote: ※ Commuting services are provided only within close proximity to the care specialist's location.
PricingDetail.breakTimes: ※ For Live-in services, 3 hours of break time per day are provided. This time can be used for rest, sleep, walking, jogging, or personal recovery. For Commuting services, 1 hour of break time per day is provided.

PricingDetail.serviceChange: ※ Service hours and scope may vary partially depending on region, schedule, and caregiver assignment.
PricingDetail.extension: ※ To extend the service period, please contact HappyMom before 50% of the initial period has elapsed.
PricingDetail.twins: ※ For twin care, please consult separately with HappyMom for details.
PricingDetail.noRefund: ※ Cancellations due to personal reasons (e.g., change of mind, finding a cheaper alternative, moving, or assistance from family/friends) are non-refundable once the contract is signed.
PricingDetail.fullRefund: ※ In the event of preterm birth or miscarriage, a full refund of the payment will be issued upon verification of supporting documents.
PricingDetail.depositRefund: ※ If the specialist is unable to proceed with the reservation due to health issues or personal reasons, we will provide guidance on receiving a deposit refund or assigning an alternative specialist.

FAQ.title:
We are here
to help.
FAQ.subtitle: We collected the most frequently asked questions. Feel free to contact us for any additional questions.

items.question: What is postpartum care service?
items.answer: Postpartum care is a professional home-visit service during the 6-8 weeks after birth to help mothers recover comfortably at home, supporting nutrition, health management, and newborn care.

items.question: How do I apply for the service?
items.answer: Please call the number at the bottom of our website or request a consultation through the Contact page.

items.question: How can I get detailed information?
items.answer: You can receive detailed service explanations and decide on your plan through a consultation with our director.

items.question: How do I review and submit the contract?
items.answer: After reviewing the contract, please submit the completed form via email.

items.question: How do I pay the deposit?
items.answer: You can transfer the deposit through the HappyMom bank account or Venmo.

items.question: How is the caregiver selected?
items.answer: After selecting a carefully screened caregiver, we arrange a phone consultation or meeting for you.

items.question: What is the reservation and cancellation policy?
items.answer: Reservations are confirmed after consultation, and cancellations/refunds are possible under specific conditions.

items.question: How is long-distance service provided?
items.answer: While a week is defined as 5 days in the contract, long-distance work involves continuous labor without days off. 15 days of work effectively equals 3 weeks of labor.

items.question: What are the caregiver's sleep and break hours?
items.answer: Especially for live-in services with frequent night feedings, the caregiver takes about 3 hours of rest between lunch and dinner.

items.question: How do I pay the service fees?
items.answer: Service fees should be paid directly to the caregiver on a weekly basis.

items.question: Are there extra costs for out-of-state service?
items.answer: For out-of-state services, the client is responsible for the caregiver's round-trip airfare.

items.question: What is the cancellation and refund policy?
items.answer: Cancellations without special reasons after signing are non-refundable. However, full refunds are issued for preterm birth or miscarriage. Please check your contract for details.

items.question: What if the reservation is cancelled due to the helper's health?
items.answer: If a reservation is cancelled due to the helper's health or personal reasons, we will refund the deposit or assign a different helper.

items.question: How do I extend the service?
items.answer: To extend, please apply at least one week in advance and pay an additional deposit.

items.question: What are the reasons for service termination?
items.answer: Service may be terminated if it becomes difficult to continue due to insults, authoritative interference from family, demands for medical acts, or excessive housework.

items.question: What is the basic family composition for the service?
items.answer: The basic composition includes the mother, newborn, and husband. Additional fees apply for extra family members.

items.question: How is the contract period determined?
items.answer: It starts on the specified date and continues until terminated by either party with prior notice.

items.question: What if my child has allergies or health issues?
items.answer: You must notify the service provider of any known allergies or health problems related to the child.

items.question: What are the duties and responsibilities of the caregiver?
items.answer: Responsibilities include meal preparation, child care, night care, laundry/cleaning suited for the child's needs, and maternal care services.

items.question: Tell me about the postpartum care service types.
items.answer:
1. Live-in: 9 AM to 9 AM next day, includes 3 hours of break. Provided 5 days a week.
2. Commuting: Mon-Fri, 9 AM to 6 PM, includes 1 hour of break.
3. Long Distance: 7 continuous days without standard holidays.
Caregivers do not drive during work hours. Night feedings require about 3 hours of daytime sleep for the caregiver.

items.question: What is the babysitting service?
items.answer: Comprehensive 1:1 care for infants over 3 months old, covering feeding, sterilization, diapering, bathing, health, nutrition, and hygiene.

items.question: What are the types of babysitting services?
items.answer: Commuting (Mon-Fri 9 AM-6 PM) and Live-in (resident at baby's home Mon-Fri) options are available.
